ValidationRule.description: Created for SALDEV-918. Used to ensure if products are deleted from Opportunity Products, Opp can't be sent to Legal until the Quote is Re-synced and missing products are back.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", Pricebook2.Name = "CPQ", NOT(ISBLANK(SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c )), Number_of_Opportunity_Products__c <> SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Number_of_Non_Amendment_Quote_Lines__c, ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Legal"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal")), Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false, SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Quote_Val_Bypass__c = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Looks like the Opportunity is missing lines. Recall Quote approval, click Edit Lines and remove unwanted line items, then Save to sync back to the Opportunity correctly.
